purpose: Teach: デルタ/ウーマン/典範/陸自/朝鮮総連/全曲/平凡社/魅惑

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、デルタ地帯への進出を検討しろ
lines.en: Look into expansion into the delta region for the company.
lines.style: Direct, commanding tone. Clipped articulation on 「当社」. No room for negotiation. Matter-of-fact delivery, eyes forward. Measured pace, weight behind each word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ウーマン向け商品ラインを強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll strengthen our product line for women.
lines.style: Respectful, professional. Quick intake of breath before response. Steady, measured confirmation. Formal register — the voice of someone taking an order and already mentally executing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内典範を整備しろ
lines.en: Prepare internal protocols for the company.
lines.style: Firm directive. Slight pause before the verb. Authoritative but not harsh — the tone of someone who expects competence. Clear enunciation. No warmth, no softness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。陸自との災害物資契約を結びます
lines.en: Understood. We'll establish a disaster supply contract with the Self-Defense Forces.
lines.style: Brief, efficient acknowledgment. Slight nod in the voice. Professional but engaged — confirming action with quiet confidence. No hesitation, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、朝鮮総連系団体との取引は慎重にしろ
lines.en: Handle dealings with organizations affiliated with the Korean Association carefully.
lines.style: Weighted pause before the key phrase. Lower register on the sensitive directive. Not harsh, but deliberate — this is advice wrapped in an order. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員向けに全曲音楽配信サービスを契約します
lines.en: Understood. We'll arrange a music streaming service for staff access to all tracks.
lines.style: Quick affirmation, then forward momentum. Professional tone, slightly brighter than previous lines. Demonstrating active compliance. Smooth delivery, no stumbling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、平凡社と共同辞典を企画しろ
lines.en: Conceive a joint dictionary project with Heibonsha for the company.
lines.style: Directive voice, measured. Slight emphasis on the strategic nature of the partnership. Clear, commanding. The tone of someone laying out a vision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。魅惑的なブランドイメージを構築します
lines.en: Understood. We'll build a compelling brand image.
lines.style: Final confirmation with subtle energy shift — slightly lighter, almost conclusive. Professional but with a thread of quiet enthusiasm. Respectful closure, ready to execute.
